pages.title: The Hungry Pickaxe
pages.text: This gold-tier pickaxe comes with Efficiency V, Fortune III, and Mending. Simply holding it grants Haste II, making it exceptionally quick for mining.

$(bold)A pickaxe with a taste for blood$()$(br)When the Centipeck reaches the end of its durability, it can keep working by draining your own health instead of breaking—as long as you have enough health to survive.$(br2)Mending still works normally, so keep gaining experience while you mine.
